result.requirement: The system shall aggregate feedback records to generate actionable insights for business strategy and operational improvement.
result.business_need: The business needs to consolidate customer feedback to identify service weaknesses, evaluate partner performance, and drive quality improvements.
functional_behaviour: The system shall collect qualitative ratings and comments from customers regarding product quality, packaging, delivery speed, and agent behavior.
The system shall categorize feedback records by service dimension to enable targeted analysis of operational performance.
The system shall calculate aggregate performance metrics for Delivery Partners and Store Partners based on submitted feedback.
The system shall expose trend analysis reports to the Platform Operator for strategic decision-making.
The system shall flag feedback records that indicate critical service failures for immediate review by the Fulfillment Supervisor.
related_information_requirements: Qualitative ratings and comments regarding product quality, packaging, delivery speed, and agent behavior.
Aggregated performance metrics derived from feedback for specific partners.
Trend analysis data showing service quality changes over time.
business_rules: A feedback record must contain both a quantitative rating and a qualitative comment to be included in aggregate reports.
Feedback records must be linked to a specific Delivery Assignment to attribute performance to the correct partner.
The system must categorize feedback into predefined service dimensions before aggregation.
Critical failure feedback must be prioritized and flagged for immediate supervisor review.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer submits a rating and comment for a completed delivery.
acceptance_criteria.then: The Feedback Record is created, categorized by service dimension, and included in the Partner performance metrics.

acceptance_criteria.given: A feedback record contains a rating indicating a critical service failure.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system aggregates the data for the Fulfillment Supervisor.
acceptance_criteria.then: The record is flagged as a critical issue and highlighted in the performance report for immediate review.
